message.content: Can you retrieve the analysis trail for the vulnerability ef903ac-893-f00 within the component AB1010CD of my project with id SUPERFANCY?

function.name: analysis_api_AnalysisApi_retrieve_analysis
function.description: Retrieves the analysis trail for a specific vulnerability within a component of a project. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the project.

component.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the component within the project.

vulnerability.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the vulnerability within the component.

function.name: finding_api_FindingApi_analyze_project
function.description: Initiates a vulnerability analysis for the specified project using its unique identifier (UUID). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the project for which the vulnerability analysis is to be triggered.

include_dependencies.description: A flag indicating whether to include project dependencies in the analysis.

priority.description: The priority level of the analysis job.

function.name: violationanalysis_api_ViolationanalysisApi_retrieve_analysis1
function.description: Retrieves a detailed trail of a specific violation analysis for a given component and policy violation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

component.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the component involved in the violation.

policyViolation.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the specific policy violation to be analyzed.
